about.title: About the App
about.greeting: Hello 👋 I'm Arcádio. Welcome to my interactive "desktop" portfolio.
about.description: This is a comprehensive portfolio presented as a fully-functional web operating system. Explore the desktop environment, interact with applications, customize settings, and discover my professional experience through an immersive OS interface.

features.windows: Full window management - drag, resize, minimize, maximize
features.desktop: Interactive desktop with draggable icons and custom positioning
features.taskbar: Dynamic taskbar with running applications and system clock
features.startMenu: Start menu with application launcher and system controls
features.themes: Dark/light theme system with automatic detection
features.wallpapers: Dynamic wallpaper system with gradients and custom images
features.bootSequence: Authentic boot sequence with configurable timing
features.lockScreen: Desktop lock functionality with unlock mechanisms
features.notes: Rich notes application with auto-save and persistent storage
features.resume: Interactive professional resume and portfolio showcase
features.calculator: Fully functional calculator with keyboard support
features.externalApps: External application integration via iframe embedding
features.settings: Comprehensive settings panel for system customization

about.tech: Built with modern web technologies: Vanilla JavaScript ES6+, TailwindCSS, HTML5 templates, localStorage persistence, responsive design, and modular architecture. Zero build tools, pure client-side implementation.

resume.title: Resume
resume.stackContent: PHP (Laravel), JS (Vue), Tailwind, MySQL, Docker, AWS.
resume.experienceContent: 8+ years in environmental compliance SaaS (BOMcheck, EC4P).
